name: Courser Eye
summary: Courser Eyes are biological reagents harvested from the antlered coursers roaming the highlands of Stonetalon Mountains. Witch Doctor Jin'Zil in Malaka'jin seeks a large quantity of them to prepare a concoction he mockingly refers to as forest magic.

sections.title: A Troll's Concoction
sections.body: In the remote outpost of Malaka'jin, Witch Doctor Jin'Zil concocts various tribal mixtures to deal with the night elves contesting the region. While stag eyes are not an uncommon component in voodoo and folk alchemy, Jin'Zil demands thirty courser eyes at once—far more than typical spellcraft requires. Blended with fey dragon scales, sap, and feline whiskers, the eyes serve as a base for a lethal brew intended for the night elf prisoners locked in cages at the back of his den.

faq.answer: They are harvested from the various coursers—both Antlered Coursers and Great Coursers—native to the higher altitudes of the Stonetalon Mountains, particularly around Mirkfallon Lake and Stonetalon Peak.

faq.q: Why does Witch Doctor Jin'Zil need so many eyes?
aliases: what does jinzil do with courser eyes
faq.answer: Jin'Zil claims that one can never have enough eyes when preparing a proper brew. He combines them with native fauna parts for the concoction he mockingly calls forest magic.

faq.q: What happens when Jin'Zil completes his forest magic potion?
aliases: what happens to the prisoners in malakajin
faq.answer: Jin'Zil plans to use his forest magic concoction on the night elf prisoners caged in his cave. Their fate is revealed when his experiment is carried out.

angles.text: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil's crude application of animal components reflects the darker, practical side of troll alchemy and mojo craft used against enemies of the Horde.
Slaughtering the coursers of Stonetalon to supply a witch doctor's cruel experiments against captured night elves affronts their reverence for nature.
